## About
British Classic Restoration is a small shop at 4222 Howard Ave in Kensington, working on classic British cars for owners across DC, Maryland and Virginia.
Cecil trained as a mechanic in London and worked on British Leyland's special diagnostic team, traveling the country to solve the problems regular dealer mechanics couldn't. Today he looks after classic Jaguar, MG, Triumph, Bentley and Aston Martin cars, along with other European vehicles.
Whether your car has been sitting too long or you're planning a full restoration, give us a call to talk through the project.

## Services
- Ground up restoration: From a light clean-up of a car that has sat too long to a full ground up restoration, including body work and paint, electrical problems, brakes and hydraulics, engine work, interiors and convertible tops.
- Minor repairs and tune-ups: Oil changes, tune-ups, brake repair and tracking down the odd pull. Even if you do your own work, it's a good idea to have a pro go over it now and then.
- Sensible upgrades: Practical improvements for driving your classic today, such as Retro-Air systems, bluetooth radios and upgraded brakes.
- Inspection of a potential purchase: Thinking about buying a classic? Call us to have it looked over before you commit.
- We buy your classic car: Inherited a car and not sure what to do with it? We buy classic, antique and vintage vehicles regardless of condition.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Send us photos and information about your car and we'll get back to you with a free quote.

Q: Will you buy a car that needs work?
A: Yes. We buy classic cars in any condition, and we can arrange pickup from anywhere in the USA.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
